question: Ajita Srivastava is a famous folk singer from _______ and she received the Padma Shri in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ajita Srivastava is renowned for her contributions to the folk music of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• She has performed various traditional forms of music that are native to the region such as Kajri, Dadra, and Thumri.
 
• Her efforts in preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of Uttar Pradesh through her music have been widely recognized.
 
• In 2022, she was honored with the prestigious Padma Shri award for her remarkable contribution to the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri Award**

 
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded by the Government of India to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity, including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• It has been awarded annually on Republic Day since 1954.
 
• The awardees receive a Sanad (certificate) signed by the President and a medallion.
 
 
 
• **Folk Music of Uttar Pradesh**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is known for its rich tradition of folk music which includes various forms such as Kajri, Dadra, Thumri, and Holi songs.
 
• These forms of music are an integral part of the cultural heritage of the state and are performed on various occasions and festivals.
 
• Folk music in Uttar Pradesh is characterized by its lyrical beauty, expressive melodies, and the use of traditional instruments.
 
• Prominent artists like Ajita Srivastava have played a significant role in preserving and popularizing these traditional music forms.
